fusions.name: Ink Cloud
fusions.desc: Looses a cone of ink that deals 8 damage to everything caught in it. It costs 4% of your maximum health, and each hit has a 40% chance of [Blunted] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Arm Lash
fusions.desc: Wraps the target in lashing arms, dealing 14 damage and knocking it back 2 tiles. It is left 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Boneless Fade
fusions.desc: Veils you for 7 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, you move 15% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Jetting Away
fusions.desc: Every time you dodge, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks part of your maximum health. Unfed, a stack fades every 8 seconds.
